text.arabic_uthmani: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

words.gloss_range: vivid Form II imperfect destruction, with the wind recovered from 46:24 as subject and the command phrase limiting its agency
words.root_gloss_range: root range of perishing and destruction, with the local Form II imperfect selecting causative, intensified destruction rather than mere intransitive ruin
words.prose: {{ar:تُدَمِّرُ}} ({{tr:tudammiru}}) replays completed devastation as a present action: the Form II shape makes the wind actively cause ruin, while the imperfect lets the scene unfold before the reader. Variant contrasts show what the canonical wording preserves: not everything perishing as subject, and not a lighter Form I verb, but external intensified agency assigned to the wind. Its subject is recovered across the boundary from the wind in 46:24, so the ayah continues the prior scene rather than restarting it. The command phrase keeps that force from reading as autonomous, and the wider destruction-of-peoples field can be compared with the different overthrow wording in 46:27.

topics.headline: Form II imperfect destruction in replay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destruction as a vivid present replay whose Form II shape makes the wind actively cause ruin, not merely accompany it.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form II imperfect with a feminine subject recovered from context, and the local object phrase licenses causative destruction.

topics.headline: qiraat contrast tests agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant readings expose how strongly the canonical wording assigns external, intensified agency to the wind.
topics.reason: The variants are useful contrasts, while the canonical parse remains Form II with the wind as subject and the totality phrase as object.

topics.headline: destruction governed by command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not read natural force as autonomous; the destructive verb is immediately bounded by command.
topics.reason: The prepositional command phrase attaches to the verb as cause or means, subordinating the wind’s action.

topics.headline: destruction of morally named peoples
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this destruction within a recurring community-judgment field and compare the nearby overthrow wording in 46:27.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete co-occurrence and same-surah evidence, while local grammar still keeps this word as the wind’s destructive action.

topics.headline: wind recovered across ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 46:25 continues the scene from 46:24 by making the previously named wind the acting subject.
topics.reason: The 3fs verb has no overt local subject, and the attachment evidence links it to the feminine wind in 46:24.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct totality governing the destroyed object-domain, felt before the authorization phrase reinscribes control
words.root_gloss_range: root range of totality and entirety; here the construct quantifier marks the whole affected object-domain
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) makes totality the direct object-domain of the destruction. Because it is construct-bound to the following indefinite thing, it is not a vague intensifier but the full sweep first felt by the reader before the phrase by its Lord’s command reinscribes control. Within the surah, this totality contrasts with 46:19, where total accounting serves degrees rather than ruin.

topics.headline: accusative construct totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the totality phrase as the direct object-domain of destruction, not as loose emphasis.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the quantifier accusative and construct-bound to the following indefinite noun.

topics.headline: total sweep reinscribed under command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the breadth of destruction first, then sees that breadth placed under the Lord’s command rather than uncontrolled force.
topics.reason: The phrase precedes the command phrase in the same clause, and the command attachment constrains the totality.

topics.headline: totality serves opposite outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare totality in 46:19, where each receives degrees, with 46:25, where every thing falls under ruin.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo has concrete references and adds a meaningful contrast without changing the local object grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite generic thing completing the totality phrase and setting up the later remnant tension
words.root_gloss_range: root range of thingness and possible entity, with local indefiniteness widening the governed domain under the totality phrase
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) completes the totality phrase with the broadest indefinite object class: any affected thing falls inside the destructive reach unless the verse itself qualifies the scope. The word can carry thingness-under-command pressure, as if the field of things stands under the command by which existence can be undone, but locally it remains the generic noun governed by the quantifier. Variant grammar tests whether every thing is the perishing subject or the destroyed object, while the canonical attachment keeps it inside the object-domain. It also prepares the tension in which total destruction is later interpreted through the one visible remnant.

topics.headline: maximally broad indefinite object class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that destruction is cast over an open class of any affected thing, not a list of named objects.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the construct complement and indefinite with tanwīn, widening the totality phrase.

topics.headline: thingness and command relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the broad field of things stands under command, while the local sense remains ordinary thingness rather than a full etymological doctrine.
topics.reason: The will-to-thing derivation is kept as pressure only; local grammar selects the generic noun inside the totality phrase.

topics.headline: variant tests subject and patient roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant grammar tests whether every thing is the perishing subject or the destroyed object.
topics.reason: The contrast is useful, but the canonical attachment keeps the phrase as object-domain of the destructive verb.

topics.headline: totality set against visible remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader expects total erasure, then has to let the later dwellings interpret the scope of that totality.
topics.reason: The later exception clause is syntactically licensed and creates the local tension between total destruction and visible remnant.

words.gloss_range: instrumental-causal preposition attaching the Lord’s command to the destructive verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the Lord’s command to the destroying verb as means and cause at once. The destruction is not allowed to close as a simple natural-force event; the preposition makes the command the channel and authorization through which the wind acts.

topics.headline: command as means and cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the command is both the means by which and the authorization because of which the wind destroys.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the preposition governing the command noun and attaching the phrase to the destructive verb.

words.gloss_range: governed command/decree in construct with its Lord, functioning as the means and authority of destruction
words.root_gloss_range: root range of command, affair, decree, and authority; here the governed maṣdar functions as the directive means and source of the destruction
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِ}} ({{tr:amri}}) is governed into the clause as the instrument-cause of destruction, then bound in construct to its Lord as source. The word carries decree, affair, and governance pressure, but the local construction selects command as the operative sense. Its delayed arrival after every thing lets the verse maximize the destructive sweep before placing it under divine directive control.

topics.headline: command governed into the verb clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command as part of the destruction mechanism, not a separate narrated order.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and remains one tight action-means unit before the result particle.

topics.headline: Lord as source of command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord is the command’s source and possessor, not the recipient of an order.
topics.reason: The construct relation with the following word is forced, and the authority collocation supports source-lordship.

topics.headline: command, affair, and authority pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears more than a bare order: the word carries decree and governance pressure while local syntax keeps command as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader root range survives as semantic pressure, but the governed prepositional phrase selects the directive/decree value.

topics.headline: authorization after total object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first feels the full destructive sweep and only then receives the phrase that places it under divine control.
topics.reason: The word order places the command phrase after the total object inside the same clause.

words.gloss_range: construct lordship with a feminine suffix referring to the wind from 46:24, subordinating natural force to its Lord
words.root_gloss_range: root range of lordship, ownership, governing, and nurture; here the construct suffix binds the wind to its Lord as authorized instrument
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهَا}} ({{tr:rabbihā}}) binds the command to the wind’s Lord through the feminine suffix, carrying the wind of 46:24 into this ayah. The title is not a bare divine label; it frames the wind as an instrument under lordship, ownership, and governance. The nurture-and-mastery range sharpens the scene because the same Lord who governs the wind authorizes judgment through it. Within the surah’s lordship thread, the word widens the field from human response and accountability to governance of nature.

topics.headline: feminine suffix binds the wind to its Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the wind from 46:24 into 46:25 through the suffix, so natural agency stays subordinated.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is strongly linked to the feminine wind from 46:24 and completes the command construct.

topics.headline: Lordship governs destructive agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind as instrument and the Lord as principal in an authority chain.
topics.reason: The construct command phrase and the recurring command-lordship pairing support the hierarchy.

topics.headline: nurture title authorizes judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the tension that the title of governing care is also the title under which annihilation is authorized.
topics.reason: The nurture/governance range is retained as title pressure, while local syntax selects the Lord of the wind in a command construct.

topics.headline: lordship extends from response to nature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track lordship from human response and accountability into governance of the wind in 46:25.
topics.reason: The same-surah and co-occurrence rows add a real discourse thread without changing the local pronoun reference.

words.gloss_range: causal-sequential particle moving immediately from destructive action to aftermath
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from process to result. It makes the people’s aftermath both immediately after and caused by the destructive action, compressing the prior scene of seeing and correction in 46:24 into the sudden result clause of 46:25.

topics.headline: immediate result hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the aftermath as both immediately after and caused by the destruction, not as a detached second scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following clause as result, matching the particle’s causal-sequential force.

topics.headline: previous scene gathered into aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle compress the prior seeing, correction, and punishment disclosure into the sudden result clause.
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently connects 46:24 with the result clause without requiring an additional local parse.

words.gloss_range: perfect kāna-type state-transition verb: the people enter the exposed state where only dwellings are seen
words.root_gloss_range: root range of morning, brightness, and becoming; here the Form IV kāna-type verb marks entry into the exposed aftermath-state
words.prose: {{ar:أَصْبَحُوا}} ({{tr:aṣbaḥū}}) seals the result after the vivid destruction: the people are supplied only by the plural ending, then defined by the state that follows, before surviving later only as a possessive trace on their dwellings. As a kāna-type verb it governs the visibility predicate, so the focus is not an action they perform but the condition they enter. Its morning/becoming range lets the aftermath feel exposed at dawn as well as grammatically transformed, turning the prior scene of seeing the wind in 46:24 into a morning-state where absence is visible.

topics.headline: plural subject only as verbal trace
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people survive grammatically as a verb ending before becoming only a possessive trace on their dwellings.
topics.reason: The perfect 3mp ending supplies the destroyed people without naming them.

topics.headline: perfect result after imperfect process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the contrast between destruction replayed as process and the aftermath stated as a sealed result.
topics.reason: The sequence moves from an imperfect destructive verb to this perfect result verb.

topics.headline: morning and becoming expose ruins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb as both state-transition and dawn exposure: morning reveals what the destruction has made them become.
topics.reason: The local kāna-type function selects becoming, while the root’s morning field remains apt for the exposed aftermath.

topics.headline: state verb governs visibility predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people defined by a visibility condition after destruction, not by a new action of their own.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following negation-exception clause as the predicate state governed by this verb.

topics.headline: perception drama becomes exposed absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from the prior ayah’s seeing of the wind to the morning-state where absence is visible.
topics.reason: The boundary row has a concrete local transition from 46:24 into the aftermath state.

words.gloss_range: negation particle opening the restriction frame over passive visibility
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the restriction by negating the field of passive seeing before any remnant is named. The reader first meets absence, and only the later exception particle restores one visible survivor. Even the long sound of the negation helps frame the exclusion that the exception will close.

topics.headline: absence before remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences absence first; the dwellings enter only after the visible field has been negated.
topics.reason: The particle negates the passive seeing verb and begins the negation-exception scope.

topics.headline: audible opening of exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the long negation answered by the long exception particle as the frame around the remnant.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but locally tied to the paired restriction particles.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect visibility verb, suppressing the observer and anchoring the negation-exception construction
words.root_gloss_range: root range of seeing, perceiving, and considering; here the passive imperfect restricts what remains visible while leaving the observer unexpressed
words.prose: {{ar:يُرَىٰ}} ({{tr:yurā}}) makes the aftermath a passive field of visibility with no named observer. The imperfect keeps the visible state open and continuing, while the negation-exception construction restricts what can be seen to the dwellings alone. Variant observer readings help show what the canonical passive avoids: it neither directly addresses one witness nor makes the divine speaker the explicit viewer. A feminine-agreeing passive variant also exposes the agreement pressure around the broken-plural dwellings, while the standard wording keeps a masculine default.

topics.headline: observer suppressed by passive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ruins as available to an unspecified witness rather than tied to one named observer.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a passive imperfect with no expressed viewing agent.

topics.headline: continuing field of perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visibility is presented as an ongoing aftermath-state, not a single glance.
topics.reason: The imperfect passive supports continuing visibility in the result clause.

topics.headline: sight becomes evidentiary perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the aftermath not only as looked at but as evidence to be perceived and understood.
topics.reason: The broader perception range is retained as evidentiary pressure, while local syntax selects passive seeing.

topics.headline: variants test who sees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant readings can make the observer addressed or divine, while the canonical passive keeps the viewer open.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows are valid contrasts but do not override the canonical passive parse.

topics.headline: variant tests agreement with dwellings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a grammar pressure point: the standard masculine default contrasts with a feminine-agreeing passive variant.
topics.reason: The variant highlights agreement pressure with the broken plural, while QAC records the canonical masculine singular passive.

topics.headline: passive verb anchors qaṣr
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands that the verse restricts the visible field itself: nothing is seen except their dwellings.
topics.reason: The negation-exception construction turns on this passive verb and the dwellings as passive subject.

topics.headline: seeing becomes evidence of erasure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track a perception thread: those who saw in 46:24 disappear, and only an impersonal field of ruins is seen in 46:25.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah and boundary rows make perception a useful thread without changing the local passive meaning.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that carves the single visible remnant from the negated field
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) converts negated visibility into exception: the dwellings are recovered from an erased field rather than introduced as ordinary scenery. Because the next word names places of dwelling and stillness, the exception leaves a charged remnant, not a neutral leftover.

topics.headline: exception restores one survivor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the dwellings as a carved-out survivor from an otherwise erased visual field.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the negation-exception restriction and introduces the sole visible item.

topics.headline: exception selects a stillness-root remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the only recovered item is a place of dwelling and stillness, making the remnant itself interpretive.
topics.reason: The convergence row is locally supported by the following dwellings noun under the exception.

words.gloss_range: plural dwellings with possessive suffix, the sole visible remnant and grammatical survivor of the passive clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of stillness, dwelling, rest, and tranquility; here the plural dwellings remain as emptied places of former settlement
words.prose: {{ar:مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ}} ({{tr:masākinuhum}}) is the sole visible remnant and the passive subject of the seeing clause. The destroyed people survive only as the possessive suffix on empty dwellings, while the root field of stillness and rest makes the remains feel like places of former tranquility emptied of inhabitants. The plural spreads the aftermath across habitations, though a singular variant can compress that footprint, and the longer plural form gives the exception a weighty landing after the short restriction particles. Ruined-dwelling testimony has parallels in 27:52 and 29:38.

topics.headline: people preserved only as possessors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destroyed community no longer acts or speaks; it remains only as a possessive suffix on empty dwellings.
topics.reason: The suffix refers to the destroyed people and is the only pronominal trace attached to the visible remnant.

topics.headline: dwellings as passive subject and sole remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the dwellings not merely as objects someone sees, but as the grammatical survivor of the visibility clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the dwellings the passive subject under the exception restriction.

topics.headline: places of rest emptied of rest-seekers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that places built for dwelling and rest remain after their inhabitants and tranquility are gone.
topics.reason: The local sense is dwellings, while the stillness and tranquility field remains a supported root pressure.

topics.headline: plural remnant tested by singular variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical plural spreads the remnant across multiple dwellings, while a singular variant can compress it into one habitation footprint.
topics.reason: The qiraat contrast is useful for number pressure; the canonical form remains a broken plural.

topics.headline: ruined dwellings as moral evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this remnant to ruined-dwelling testimony in 27:52 and 29:38.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete ruined-dwelling parallels, and the local exception gives the same testimonial role.

topics.headline: long plural slows the landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the longer plural form as a weighty landing after the short restriction particles.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local and modest but gives the sole remnant an audible weight.

words.gloss_range: comparative proclitic turning the narrated destruction into the manner-template for recompense
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) turns the narrated scene into a comparison-template for what follows. Joined with the demonstrative, it gives a compact formula that points and compares at once, moving from destruction and remnant to recompense maxim without spelling out the full comparison.

topics.headline: kāf makes the event a manner-standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the narrated destruction become the source-side of a comparison for divine recompense.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as comparative/deictic, and attachment evidence links it to the recompense verb through the demonstrative.

topics.headline: compact comparison-plus-pointing formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the compact formula moves quickly from scene to maxim without spelling out the full comparison.
topics.reason: The written proclitic and the elided comparison are locally coherent, while the supplied ellipsis remains explanatory rather than a new route.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative pointer packaging the whole destruction-and-aftermath scene as a reusable principle
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) points back to the whole destruction-and-aftermath sequence, not to one nearby noun. That backward pointer also makes the scene reusable: the ruin of the people becomes a principle by which the final divine declaration is read. The word therefore closes the narrative example and opens the maxim, while the opening destruction and closing criminality make the event morally interpreted.

topics.headline: demonstrative packages destruction and aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the demonstrative point back to the whole event-sequence, not to one nearby noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly says the demonstrative refers back to the just narrated destruction pattern.

topics.headline: specific ruin becomes general maxim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hinge from narrated past into an ongoing theological principle.
topics.reason: The demonstrative phrase opens the final similative statement and connects the prior scene to present-tense recompense.

topics.headline: destruction interpreted by criminal severance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening destruction and closing criminality as a moral frame, so ruin is interpreted rather than merely reported.
topics.reason: The row gives an end-to-end lexical frame that is locally visible in the ayah’s first and last roots.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural imperfect of recompense, shifting into divine speech and stating an ongoing punitive pattern
words.root_gloss_range: root range of recompensing, returning, rewarding, and punishing; here the object and final adjective select punitive proportional return
words.prose: {{ar:نَجْزِي}} ({{tr:najzī}}) shifts the ayah into first-person divine speech: after the narration of what the wind did and what the people became, the divine We claims the pattern. The imperfect makes recompense ongoing, and the root’s neutral range of reward or punishment is locally narrowed by the criminal people to punitive proportional return. The clause also participates in a recurring judgment formula, with parallels such as 7:40 and 10:13.

topics.headline: imperfect divine We claims the pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the shift from narrated destruction to divine first-person speech claiming an ongoing practice.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a first-person plural imperfect, and the discourse shift is explicit after third-person narration.

topics.headline: neutral recompense selected as punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees punishment here as proportional return; the root can reward or punish, but the local object selects the punitive branch.
topics.reason: The root range is broader than punishment, while the direct object and final adjective restrict the local valence.

topics.headline: formula turns ruins into rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final clause as a recurring judgment formula, with parallels such as 7:40 and 10:13, not a one-off historical aside.
topics.reason: The supplied formula rows give concrete references and the local clause matches the judgment pattern.

words.gloss_range: definite singular collective object of recompense, both the known people and a category under judgment
words.root_gloss_range: root range of standing, rising, and communal identity; here the singular collective noun names the recompensed social body
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) is the direct object of recompense: many persons are gathered as one collective people under judgment. Its definiteness can point to the known people and to the category made by the final rule. The standing/rising root adds irony after collapse, and the following adjective turns the group from a social or geographical community into a juridical category. The noun also names, at the close, the collective target whose devastation opened the ayah.

topics.headline: community receives recompense as one object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many destroyed individuals gathered into one collective object under recompense.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun accusative as the direct object of the recompense verb.

topics.headline: definite people as known group and type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the definite noun can point to the known people and also support the final clause as a category.
topics.reason: QAC notes definiteness with specific or categorical force, matching the final generalizing statement.

topics.headline: standing root against collapsed community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a people-name from standing and rising now names a collapsed community.
topics.reason: The root image is retained as pressure, while the local noun functions as the collective people under recompense.

topics.headline: people specified by criminal adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a geographical or social community become a juridical category through the following criminal adjective.
topics.reason: The adjective agreement is licensed and the qawm-mujrim pairing supports the collective verdict.

topics.headline: opening destruction names its collective target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the opening devastation to the closing community named as its object of judgment.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence row links the opening destruction field with the community noun inside this ayah.

words.gloss_range: definite Form IV active participle modifying the people and sealing the ayah with a moral verdict
words.root_gloss_range: root range of cutting, severance, and criminality; here the Form IV active participle supplies the closing moral identity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimīna}}) supplies the ayah’s final moral verdict. It agrees with the people as a definite accusative adjective, so it identifies the same recompensed collective rather than adding a new object. The Form IV active participle makes criminality an agentive identity, and the severance pressure of the root answers the opening destruction by explaining why recompense is punitive; the same-surah loss echo points back to 46:18. The hard final cluster gives the closing verdict a compact cutting texture that matches the severance image.

topics.headline: definite adjective seals the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final word morally identifies the same recompensed people and explains why the recompense is punitive.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite accusative adjective agreeing with the collective object.

topics.headline: criminal severance answered by destruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the closing criminality as severance from right order, answered by the destructive severing of their world.
topics.reason: The cutting/severance image is retained as root pressure, while the local form remains the standard criminal participle.

topics.headline: active participle marks agentive criminal identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees criminality as an active identity-form, not merely an external label placed after the fact.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV active participle, and the occurrence profile supports participial judgment language.

topics.headline: crime placed under recompense relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final adjective locked into the recompense formula rather than left as an isolated moral label.
topics.reason: The local pairing with the recompense verb and agreed object supports the formulaic relation.

topics.headline: criminal verdict echoes 46:18 loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the criminal people in 46:25 with the destroyed losers vocabulary of 46:18.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows provide a concrete reference and show accumulated moral classification.

topics.headline: hard cluster matches closing verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compact final consonant cluster reinforce the severity of the closing verdict.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the final word and supports a modest sound-shape payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The destructive verb at word 1, the totalizer and object at words 2-3, the command-governor construction at words 4-5, and the exclusive visibility of dwellings at words 8-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sovereign command delegates exhaustive destructive action, but the explicit visual remainder constrains its domain: totality covers the relevant occupants, powers, and destructible contents rather than asserting that no physical object survives.

activation_trace.role: The annihilating sense supplies the physical process and makes the action eradication rather than ordinary damage.
The enclosing and completing sense supplies exhaustive quantification, while the stated remainder determines its local domain.
The maximally general reportable-entity sense supplies the class over which the totalizer ranges.
The obligating command sense supplies delegated authorization and makes the destructive agent obedient rather than autonomous.
The mastery and ownership sense supplies the sovereign source that authorizes and bounds the action.
The change-of-state sense supplies the abrupt conversion from inhabited collectivity to aftermath.
The ordinary visual sense makes inspectable residue, not merely death, the endpoint of the process.
The residential sense supplies the surviving built container and functions as the explicit exception to total erasure.

changed_reading.after: A commanded agent exhausts its assigned domain so completely that only the built containers of the former life remain visually identifiable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vacancy-capable destruction root at word 1 and the contrast between passive seeing at word 8 and dwellings or households at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can model destruction as removal of occupancy and agency rather than pulverization of every structure: the household disappears while its habitation shell remains available to sight.

activation_trace.role: The root's house-vacancy idiom supplies an endpoint in which no occupant remains and makes emptiness itself a mode of destruction.
The entering-place sense supplies invasive penetration of settled space rather than destruction acting only on an exterior surface.
The causative display sense foregrounds the aftermath as a scene made available to later viewers.
The household sense supplies the absent human collective that had occupied the surviving place.
The dwelling sense supplies the fixed shell that remains when the household counterpart is removed.
The people-group sense identifies the destroyed target as a social body rather than masonry alone.

changed_reading.before: The surviving houses are a minor exception among otherwise smashed objects.
changed_reading.after: The empty houses are the designed result: destruction has converted inhabited social space into a visible shell without a household.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recompense formula at words 12-14 retrospectively governs the destructive process at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing clause turns the event into reciprocal execution against an earning, culpable collective. The cutting potential of the culpability root adds social cutoff: the group is removed from continuity while its place remains.

activation_trace.role: The act-for-act repayment sense supplies the judicial relation between prior conduct and present ruin.
The acquisition sense supplies culpability as something gained through action and therefore answerable by repayment.
The offense sense identifies the moral status that makes the destructive event a sentence rather than an accident.
The cutting sense supplies the material-social image of a community severed from further continuity.
The collective sense supplies a corporate target for the reciprocal action.
The authority sense supplies an executing jurisdiction behind the repayment.
The eradication sense supplies the sentence's realized material consequence.

changed_reading.before: The final moral label comments on a natural disaster after the fact.
changed_reading.after: The disaster is narrated as an authorized reciprocal sentence that cuts off a culpable social body.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The standing-capable collective at word 13 is juxtaposed with the motionless habitation field at word 10 and the cutting culpability field at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: A community that stood, acted, and maintained itself is deactivated: collective motion is cut off and only fixed place remains. This is a social-spatial mechanism, not an alternative lexical translation of the surface words.

activation_trace.role: The bodily standing sense supplies the latent image of a collective held upright as an active presence.
The stopping and exhaustion sense supplies the collapse of that active collective posture.
The cessation-of-motion sense supplies the static condition into which the social scene is converted.
The stable-place sense supplies the spatial remainder after social agency has ceased.
The cutting sense supplies the arrow from living continuity to severed collective presence.
The visual sense makes the static spatial remainder available as the only observable state.

changed_reading.before: A named people are physically destroyed.
changed_reading.after: A standing social organism is converted into motionless place: its capacity to act disappears before its spatial shell does.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context places events under a real fixed endpoint, asks for a surviving trace, and repeatedly frames disclosure as visible sign and witness. The focus's remaining dwellings can therefore function as evidence of what happened, not only as debris.

activation_trace.role: The reality-matching sense supplies an objective order within which the later aftermath can bear truthful evidence.
The fixed temporal-limit sense supplies a scheduled endpoint rather than an arbitrary interruption.
The lasting-mark sense supplies a residue that points backward to a vanished prior state, the role later filled by the dwellings.
The manifest-sign sense supplies the context's recurrent demand that events become legible indications.
The disclosure sense supplies emergence into visibility and makes the surviving scene evidentiary.
The attesting-mark sense supplies an object that can testify without the former inhabitants being present.
The visual sense turns the aftermath into something available for inspection.
The dwelling sense supplies the durable object that carries the evidentiary role.

structural_cues: The packet moves from a fixed endpoint in 46:3 to a demand for prior trace in 46:4 and repeated display or witness language before the focus.
The focus's exclusive construction makes the dwellings the sole item admitted into the final visual field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed limit, surviving trace, manifest sign, witness, and an exclusive visible remainder; I infer that the remainder is made to testify. A live alternative is that the houses are incidental ruins with no designed evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The houses are merely what happened not to be destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The houses are the selected visible trace through which an absent people's end remains verifiable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence establishes reward for deeds, graded outcomes, complete payment, and humiliating punishment tied to conduct. The focus's comparison formula then reads as one exact entry in a reciprocal ledger rather than indiscriminate force.

activation_trace.role: The reciprocal-payment sense first supplies positive outcome as a response to deeds, establishing the ledger's two-sided structure.
The step-by-step grading sense supplies differentiated levels rather than undifferentiated collective fate.
The intentional-action sense supplies the conduct to which each outcome answers.
The no-deficiency sense supplies full settlement and makes the later destruction an execution of completed accounting.
The reciprocal-payment sense supplies the punitive side of the same account immediately before the focus narrative.
The abasement sense supplies social reversal as part of the paid consequence, not merely bodily injury.
The focus repeats reciprocal payment and explicitly classifies the ruin within that established account.
The acquisition sense supplies earned liability as the account's input.
The eradication sense supplies the severe but narratively accounted-for payment.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from reward for deeds in 46:14 to graded, complete settlement in 46:19 and punitive repayment for stated conduct in 46:20.
The focus closes with a comparison formula that generalizes its event as a recurring mode of repayment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deeds, grades, full payment, punitive repayment, and the focus's analogous repayment clause; I infer a single judicial accounting mechanism. The live alternative is that these are only thematic parallels and the storm's physical extent is not itself proportional.

changed_reading.before: Total ruin looks like a blunt collective penalty.
changed_reading.after: The ruin is presented as the material settlement of an already graded moral account, with humiliation and social extinction among its paid outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a front appears, faces the valleys, and is misread as beneficial rain before being identified as forceful air carrying punishment. The focus completes the reversal: what entered their visual field as provision removes the viewers themselves and leaves only their fixed habitations visible.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary sight supplies the inhabitants' initial act of classification and makes perceptual error causal to the reversal.
The thing-appearing-from-a-direction sense supplies an incoming front whose visible aspect invites interpretation.
The transient-occurrence sense supplies unstable appearance and supports the rapid collapse of the first reading.
The face-to-face sense supplies direct orientation of the front toward inhabited terrain.
The flood-channel sense supplies a topographic conduit by which an apparently rain-bearing front reaches settlement space.
The sky-water sense supplies the expected beneficial reading that the narrative immediately overturns.
The moving-air sense supplies the actual material agent behind the deceptive front.
The force and dominance sense supplies the wind's capacity to overmatch the settled landscape.
The punitive-pain sense supplies the reversal from anticipated provision to inflicted consequence.
The entering-place sense turns the incoming front into an invasive process that penetrates the space it faced.
The annihilation sense supplies the terminal action concealed by the front's first appearance.
Sight returns at the endpoint, but now belongs to an external observer confronting absence.
The dwelling sense supplies the fixed object that survives the reversal of who can see and who can be seen.

structural_cues: The focus directly continues 46:24's contrastive reidentification of the approaching front.
Sight occurs before the event with the inhabitants as viewers and after it in a passive construction with the inhabitants absent from view.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a seen front, anticipated rain, corrective identification as punitive wind, and a final field containing only dwellings; I infer a designed reversal from mis-seeing benefit to becoming unseen. A live alternative is simple chronological foreshadowing without a perception-centered mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus straightforwardly reports what a destructive wind did.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes a perceptual trap: a community misreads what it sees, then the same arrival removes that community from sight while preserving the objects that expose its error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah says that established people possessed sight and other faculties, yet none of those resources availed them in any respect because they knowingly denied signs, and the mocked consequence enclosed them. This recasts destroying every thing as cancellation of every effective capacity while material dwellings can remain.

activation_trace.role: The empowerment sense supplies the prior capacity and security whose practical value is then canceled.
Ordinary eyesight supplies a faculty repeatedly possessed but unable to produce saving recognition.
The sufficiency sense supplies the explicit test of whether any faculty or resource can protect its owner.
The general entity sense supplies the negative counterpart to the focus's exhaustive object phrase: not one effective thing avails.
The knowing-denial sense supplies the failure that converts available perception into useless capacity.
The manifest-sign sense supplies what their faculties should have recognized but did not operationalize.
The descending-and-enclosing-harm sense supplies closure around the formerly empowered people.
The exhaustive sense now ranges functionally over capacities and defenses, not only over objects.
The visual sense becomes ironic because those who had sight are no longer available to be seen.
The stable-place sense supplies matter that can persist after every saving function associated with its occupants has failed.

structural_cues: The immediate next ayah repeats three human faculties before negating their benefit.
Its negative any-thing construction mirrors the focus's every-thing construction, while the focus's passive sight clause supplies the irony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior empowerment, sight, total non-availing, knowing denial, and enclosing consequence; I infer that the focus's total destruction includes total loss of efficacy. The live alternative is that 46:26 merely explains moral cause after a physically exhaustive event.

changed_reading.before: Every thing denotes the inventory of physical objects struck by the wind.
changed_reading.after: Every thing also denotes every capacity that could have made the inhabitants secure: emplacement, perception, judgment, and defense all become ineffective before the walls cease to be visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following context broadens the single aftermath into surrounding settlements repeatedly destroyed and signs repeatedly turned so viewers might return. The focus's dwellings become one addressable node in a landscape archive rather than an isolated ruin.

activation_trace.role: The falling-into-extinction sense supplies recurrence of the focus event beyond one community.
The surrounding-direction sense supplies a spatial network of comparable aftermaths around the addressees.
The people-gathered-in-settlement sense supplies the same fusion of social body and built place that the focus splits apart.
The gathering-into-a-fixed-container sense supplies settlement as a durable receptacle after its gathered people vanish.
The repeated turning from state to state supplies active re-presentation of ruined settlements as signs.
The visible-marker sense assigns communicative work to the repeated aftermaths.
The return sense supplies the intended response from living viewers who encounter those markers.
The dwelling sense supplies the concrete settlement-remnant through which the recurring sign can be read.
The household sense supplies the missing social content whose absence makes the remnant legible.

structural_cues: The immediate next movement pluralizes destruction across settlements around the present audience.
The purpose clause in 46:27 points from repeated signs toward a possible return by later viewers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearby destroyed settlements, repeated sign-presentation, intended return, and the focus's visible dwellings; I infer a landscape archive in which ruins address later communities. The alternative is a general historical reminder with no special semiotic role for surviving buildings.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are a local physical remainder.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are one preserved address in a wider landscape of settlement-signs meant to turn later communities back.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the settlement-remains, acquired cultic intermediaries fail to help and disappear; later, non-response leaves no escape and no protective allies. The focus's totality can therefore include a whole patronage and refuge system whose nodes fail, while the dwellings remain as failed shelters.

activation_trace.role: The helping-and-prevailing sense supplies the protective function explicitly tested and found absent.
The acquiring-and-adopting sense supplies deliberately constructed patronage rather than accidental association.
The devotional-approach sense supplies the claimed route by which intermediaries were expected to secure access and aid.
The disappearance sense supplies the vanishing of the supposed protectors at the moment their function is needed.
The eluding-pursuit sense supplies the escape route explicitly closed to the non-responder.
The protective-alliance sense supplies the social support network explicitly denied.
The exhaustive sense supplies collapse across every node of aid, escape, and shelter.
The legitimate-authority sense stands over and displaces the failed rival patronage system.
The stable-place sense supplies a refuge-shaped object that remains after its protective function has failed.

structural_cues: 46:28 negates aid at the destroyed settlements, and 46:32 doubles the closure by denying both escape on earth and protective allies.
The focus subordinates the destructive agent to one authority while the later context empties rival authorities of function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed intermediaries, disappearance, inability to elude, absence of allies, and the focus's exhaustive commanded destruction; I infer collapse of a protection graph. The live alternative is that the focus concerns bodies and property only, with failed patronage supplied as a separate theological lesson.

changed_reading.before: The wind destroys people and possessions.
changed_reading.after: The commanded event destroys every claimed relation of protection as well: patrons vanish, escape closes, and even habitation ceases to shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later creation and resurrection claim repeats the all-plus-thing construction while assigning comprehensive capability directly to God. Against that universal frame, the focus deliberately marks the wind's destruction as commanded by its governor, calibrating the wind's totality as delegated and task-bounded.

activation_trace.role: The visual sense reopens the demand to perceive correctly and frames the universal-power statement as something inferable from creation.
The originating-creation sense supplies an unambiguously comprehensive divine operation against which the wind's operation is measured.
The effective-capacity sense supplies the ultimate ability to act and possess, distinguishing source power from delegated agency.
The planned-measure sense supplies ordering and allocation, supporting a bounded commission within wider power.
The living-being sense supplies restoration of the very kind of occupants absent from the focus's dwellings.
The loss-of-life sense supplies a reversible state under divine power rather than an absolute limit on that power.
The exhaustive sense supplies the repeated quantifier whose scope can be compared directly with the focus.
The general entity sense supplies the repeated object class, now governed by direct universal capability.
The annihilation sense supplies the delegated operation whose scope is being calibrated.
The command sense supplies the explicit delegation arrow from sovereign capacity to destructive agent.
The mastery sense identifies the governor whose universal capacity exceeds the agent's assigned task.

structural_cues: The all-plus-thing collocation recurs in 46:33 with direct divine capability, while the focus inserts an explicit command-governor phrase after the wind's action.
The dwellings already provide an internal exception-like remainder inside the focus's scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition, direct universal capability in 46:33, and explicit delegation in the focus; I infer a hierarchy of scopes in which the wind is total only within its commission. The live alternative is that both totality phrases are independent rhetorical universals with no intended calibration.

changed_reading.before: The wind itself is described with unqualified universal destructive power.
changed_reading.after: The wind is exhaustive only as an assigned instrument; the repeated later formula reserves unbounded all-thing capability for the authority that commands it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's morning and change-of-state pivot is later paired with people seeing the promised event as though they had remained only a brief part of a day, followed by selective communal extinction. A long-established society is compressed into visible residue within one perceived interval.

activation_trace.role: The visual sense supplies a future viewpoint from which prior duration is radically remeasured.
The delay-and-slowing sense supplies duration only to have that duration denied or compressed.
The daylight-opening sense supplies the short day-scale against which historical residence is measured.
The extinction sense supplies the same terminal conversion from enduring community to absence.
The people-group sense supplies the communal unit whose long duration can collapse at the endpoint.
The first-light sense supplies the concrete overnight threshold at which the ruined state becomes visible.
The becoming sense supplies abrupt state conversion alongside, but not necessarily identical with, literal morning.
The annihilation sense supplies the event that compresses a society's apparent permanence into an aftermath.

structural_cues: The focus marks its result with a form that can signal both morning and becoming.
The closing ayah combines future seeing, a fraction-of-a-day comparison, and an exclusive communal-destruction formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies morning or becoming, future seeing, radically shortened perceived stay, and communal extinction; I infer temporal compression as part of the focus's force. The live alternative is that the focus uses a routine change-of-state form and 46:35's time comparison is exclusively eschatological.

changed_reading.before: Morning simply dates when the destruction was noticed.
changed_reading.after: Morning is also a compression hinge: an apparently durable civilization crosses one threshold and is retrospectively reduced to a brief stay plus residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates hunting-hide and vacancy branches rather than the surface verb's dominant annihilation sense. It remains anchored in the destruction root, its invasion of place, the house-versus-household split, and the wind entering valley space. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for how the storm removes occupants and perceptible trace, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 can activate entering, concealment in a hunter's station, and house-vacancy images; word 10 separates habitation from household, and the exclusive sight clause reports the resulting absence.

activation_trace.role: The entering-place sense supplies the storm as an invader that penetrates the occupants' own enclosure.
The hunter's scent-masking smoke sense supplies an exploratory mechanism of suppressing the occupants' detectable trace.
The house-vacancy idiom supplies the endpoint in which built space remains but no person answers from it.
The household sense supplies the prey-like social content removed from the enclosure.
The dwelling sense supplies the lair-like shell left available to sight.
The flood-channel sense supplies a route by which the incoming agent penetrates the inhabited terrain.
The moving-air sense supplies the actual carrier for the intrusion-and-erasure analogy.

changed_reading.before: The wind openly smashes a settlement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the wind behaves like an invasive hunter: it enters the habitat and erases the occupants' detectable presence while their lairs remain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant cutting inventory mapped from the recompense root and aligns it with cutting, earning, and harvest-remnant branches under the culpability root. The focus itself anchors both roots in its closing sentence and joins them to eradication. Downstream prose should qualify this as a latent harvest or shearing analogy for earned judgment, not as the lexical meaning of the surface recompense verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recompense word at 12 has a split cutting inventory, while the culpability word at 14 carries cutting, earning, offense, and dry-remnant possibilities beside the destructive verb at 1.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant shearing sense supplies judgment as a decisive cutting operation.
The cutting-at-ripeness sense supplies an appointed harvest moment for the consequence.
The fallen-clipping sense supplies material residue after the cutting operation.
The cutting sense independently reinforces severance as the penalty's material analogy.
The dry post-harvest remnant sense supplies what is left after productive life has been removed.
The earning sense supplies the judicial arrow from acquired conduct to harvested consequence.
The offense sense keeps the harvest analogy morally anchored rather than merely seasonal.
The eradication sense supplies the actual catastrophic event to which the harvest image is analogically attached.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an abstract legal label attached to ruin.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense materializes as a harvest-like cutting of what culpable action has ripened, leaving only residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant growth and rain-cloud mappings under two focus roots whose surface senses are lordship and sight. The immediately preceding expected-rain and actual-wind sequence keeps the activation materially connected to the focus. Downstream prose should mark it as a split-root ecological counterimage: a normally nourishing atmospheric system is reversed into removal, not as an alternative parsing of the surface forms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The governor word at 5 has both cloud and non-dominant growth inventories, the sight word at 8 has a non-dominant rain-cloud inventory, and the focus opposes that atmospheric field to eradication and empty dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The layered-cloud sense supplies a meteorological counterimage within the focus's governor root.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth sense supplies the life-raising function that the destructive event reverses.
The non-dominant heavy-rain-cloud sense supplies the atmospheric object expected to nourish the valleys.
The falling-rain sense supplies the inhabitants' expected ecological benefit.
The moving-air sense supplies the actual atmospheric process whose function is reversed.
The flood-channel sense supplies terrain ordinarily organized to receive and distribute rain.
The annihilation sense supplies the opposed output: the atmospheric arrival removes life instead of raising it.
The dwelling sense supplies the barren infrastructure left after the ecological function has inverted.

changed_reading.before: A dangerous storm replaces an expected rainstorm.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the event reverses the ecology of cloud, valley, and growth: the system expected to raise life instead strips life from its habitation.

strongest_changes: The false-rain sequence turns the focus into a reversal of visibility: those who misread the approaching front become unseen, while their dwellings remain visible.
The next ayah's total failure of sight and other faculties shifts every thing from a purely physical inventory toward every effective capacity and defense.
The graded repayment sequence makes the destruction an authorized settlement of acquired conduct rather than an arbitrary natural catastrophe.
The repeated all-thing construction in 46:33 distinguishes the wind's task-bounded delegated totality from the governor's universal capability.
The surviving settlement can function simultaneously as empty shell, witness-bearing trace, and one node in a repeated landscape of signs.
summary.what_was_special: The focus contains an internal tension between exhaustive destruction and surviving dwellings. Context does not dissolve it; it activates several mechanisms for it: bounded commission, cancellation of efficacy, perceptual reversal, failed refuge, and evidentiary preservation. Split-root inventories also expose contained hunter, harvest, and reversed-growth analogies that would disappear in a consensus-only reading.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether the totalizer is primarily bounded by physical class, inhabited territory, practical efficacy, or several of these at once.
The dwellings may be intact structures, merely recognizable remains, or a grammatical way of emphasizing complete human absence.
The evidentiary and landscape-archive roles are strongly sequenced but still reader-supplied functional arrows rather than explicit labels in the focus.
The hunter, harvest, ecological-reversal, social-unstanding, and compressed-time readings should remain exploratory analogies rather than surface translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Destruction works by entry, not only impact from outside.** د م ر B001 is entering into a place and B002 is destructive ruin. The wind faces the valleys in 46:24, then `تدمر` everything. I infer that channel-entry enables comprehensive ruin. The verb therefore carries a mechanism: destructive force penetrates the inhabited system before dismantling it.
2. **Dwellings remain as immobilized evidence.** س ك ن B002 is dwelling and settlement, while B001 is cessation of motion. After the people disappear, only their `مساكن` are visible. I infer that the surviving settlements become stilled witnesses whose lack of inhabitants demonstrates the event. The image is not simply ruins left over; it is habitation converted into motionless testimony.
3. **Morning opens onto a reversed scene of visibility.** ص ب ح B001 is dawn and morning opening; ر ء ي B001 is seeing by eye or insight. The temporal shift `فأصبحوا` coincides with the visual restriction `لا يرى إلا`. I infer that daylight, normally expanding visibility, reveals radical absence. Morning therefore functions as disclosure, not merely a timestamp.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:26 identifies the failed inner capacities of the vanished inhabitants, turning the remaining dwellings into evidence of cognition refused, not merely bodies removed. 46:33 then makes seeing creation the corrective use of perception.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The wind’s comprehensive force remains commissioned rather than autonomous.** `تُدَمِّرُ` activates د م ر B002, causing destructive ruin; `كُلَّ` activates ك ل ل B003, encompassing totality, and `بِأَمْرِ` activates ء م ر B002, an obligatory directive. `رَبِّهَا` activates ر ب ب B001, authority and ownership. The packet makes the wind the grammatical destroyer but attaches its action to its Lord’s command. I infer nested agency: the force genuinely acts, yet the scope and authority of that act are received. This answers 46:23’s ownership distinction at the level of the event itself.

2. **The dwelling remains visible after the inhabitant–dwelling relation is emptied.** `فَأَصْبَحُوا` activates ص ب ح B010, becoming in a new state, with B001 locating the disclosed state at the morning opening; `مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ` activates س ك ن B002, dwellings, against B003, household inhabitants. Most sharply, د م ر B006 is the fixed formula “not a soul in the house,” activated beside the primary ruin branch by `لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ`. The packet leaves structures visible and persons absent; I infer that the remnant material shell witnesses the severed relation it once housed. Destruction is shown not as featureless erasure but as habitation without inhabitants.

3. **The episode becomes a general model of earned consequence.** `نَجْزِى` activates ج ز ي B001, requital matching an act; `ٱلْقَوْمَ` activates ق و م B001, a constituted people, and `ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ` activates ج ر م B004, offenders, with B003 adding earning or causing to incur. `كَذَٰلِكَ` turns the narrated outcome into a comparison rule. The packet supplies that generalization; I infer that criminality is not only a label preceding punishment but the process by which a community incurs its matching return. The visible dwellings become the worked example of that rule.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:27 expanded the surviving dwellings into a regional evidence system: ruined settlements activate ق ر ي B001 around the addressees through ح و ل B004. The later ayah made 46:25’s empty houses more than local aftermath; repeated remnants become a traversable ring of testimony intended to prompt return.

baseline.text: Rabbinin emriyle her şeyi yok eder. Sonunda yalnız konutları görünür oldu. Suçlu topluluğu işte böyle cezalandırırız.

findings.text: Yıkım yalnızca dışarıdan vurmaz; vadilerden içeri giren güç, yerleşik düzenin içine sızdıktan sonra onu dağıtır.
Rüzgâr gerçek bir fail olarak yıkar, fakat kapsamı ve yetkisi aldığı buyruğa bağlıdır; böylece etkinlik ile kaynak otoritesi iç içe fakat ayrı kalır.
İçinde kimse kalmayan konutlar, yerleşim ile sakinleri arasındaki kopmuş bağı gösteren hareketsiz maddi tanıklara dönüşür.
Normalde görünürlüğü artıran sabah, burada yeni bir nesneler dünyası göstermek yerine insanların kökten yokluğunu açığa çıkarır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (46:15-25): Promised Arrival, Rain Expectation, and Stripping Wind
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An demanded arrival is first misrecognized as benefit, then discloses its contrary force and removes the settled world that expected to receive it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hydrological, irrigation, wind-force, and harvest branches slow the scene into distinct stages of approach, intake, reversal, and stripping.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Destruction harvests the inhabited field
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A totalizing force cuts through what had been settled until only empty dwellings remain available to sight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Annihilation (`quranic:root_000487:B002/m01`); cutting or harvesting (`quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`); totality (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); transition into a new state (`quranic:root_000839:B010/m01`); settled dwellings (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `تدمر كل شيء بأمر ربها`, `فأصبحوا لا يرى إلا مساكنهم`, and `نجزي القوم المجرمين` (46:25).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The wind behaves like a negative harvest: it removes the inhabitants and leaves the built husks as the only visible crop.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, kök anlamını bir eve, bir topluluğun yanına veya başka bir yere girme olarak kurar. İzinsiz olma kimi aktarımlarda belirleyici bir sınırdır; avcının gizlenme yerine ve kirpinin yuvasına girmesi ise bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği bir yerin içine girmedir; izinsizlik her kullanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Basit biçimler genel giriş anlamını taşırken kirpinin yuvasına girmesi belirli bir özne ve yerle sınırlıdır; bu özel kullanım yalın anlama genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir eve, bir topluluğun yanına veya başka bir yere içeri girmektir. Bazı kullanımlarda izinsiz girişe daralır; avcının gizlenme yerine ve kirpinin yuvasına girmesi bunun özel örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Bir evin, topluluğun bulunduğu yerin veya başka bir yerin içine girme hareketidir.
Kimi aktarımlarda giriş, sahibinden izin alınmadan yapılan girişle sınırlandırılır.
Avcının gizlenme yerine veya kirpinin kendi yuvasına girmesi yer ve özne bakımından özel örneklerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü hem bir varlık veya topluluğun yok olup gitmesini hem de bir şeyi bu sona uğratmayı açıkça kapsar. Kökten ortadan kaldırma, sıradan hasardan daha güçlü bir sınırdır; kayıp ve son buluşla kurulan söz dizisi ise çekirdeğin kalıplaşmış bir pekiştirmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, edilgen ya da kendiliğinden yok oluş ile başkasını yok oluşa uğratma çerçevelerini birlikte kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Basit yok oluş ve yok etme biçimleri ile belirli söz birlikleri ayrı tutulur; kayıp, yıkım ve son buluşu sıralayan kalıp tek başına yalın kök anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık veya topluluğun yok oluşa varacak ölçüde mahvolması ya da ona bu sonucun yaşatılmasıdır. Bazı kullanımlar kökünü kazımayı vurgular; kalıplaşmış bir sıralamada kayıp ve son bulmayla birlikte anılır.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın veya topluluğun varlığını sürdüremeyecek biçimde mahvolup yok olmasıdır.
Bir etkileyenin başka bir şeyi yok oluşa uğratması ve bütünüyle ortadan kaldırmasıdır.
Kalıplaşmış bir niteleme dizisinde kayba uğrama, mahvolma ve sonu gelmeyle birlikte pekiştirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar yok olma ve yok etme çekirdeğinde birleşir; kimileri sonucun kökten ve eksiksiz oluşunu, kimileri de bir etkileyenin bu sonucu başka bir şeye vermesini açıklar. Bir söz dizisi anlamı kayıp ve son bulmayla pekiştirir.

concept_gloss.text: kökten yok olma ve yok etme

identity_judgment.rationale: Avcının, av hayvanı insan kokusunu almasın diye gizlenme yerini deve tüyü gibi kıllarla tütsülemesi açıkça aktarılır. Ancak bu işi yapan avcıya ilgili adın sıfat olarak verilip verilemeyeceği kaynak sözünün kendi içinde tartışmalıdır; dal eylemi koruyabilir, yapanın adı konusunda hüküm veremez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız avcının koku gizlemek için yaptığı tütsüleme işini tanımlar; tartışmalı yapan adını doğrulamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş bir sözlük birimi bulunmadığından anlam yalın köke bağlanmaz; tanım yalnızca kaynakta anlatılan avcılık uygulamasıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Avcının, av hayvanı kokusunu almasın diye gizlenme yerini deve tüyü veya başka kılları yakarak tütsülemesidir. Bu işi yapan avcıya ilgili adın verilip verilemeyeceği konusunda aktarım ayrılığı vardır.

facets.statement: Avcı, av hayvanının kendi kokusunu sezmesini önlemek için gizlenme yerinde kıl yakıp duman çıkarır.
Uygulama avcılık ortamına, avcının gizlenme yerine ve insan kokusunu örtme amacına bağlıdır.
İşi yapan avcının bu eylemden türetilen bir adla nitelenip nitelenemeyeceği konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, avcının insan kokusunu av hayvanından gizlemek için saklanma yerinde deve tüyü veya başka kıllar yakmasını anlatır. Ayrılık, uygulamanın kendisinde değil, bu işi yapan avcıya ilgili adın verilip verilemeyeceğindedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, küçük ve kısa ya da biçimi kötü ve eti sıkı diye nitelenen bir çöl sıçanı türünü tanımlar; aynı niteleyicinin aşağılık görülen bir erkek için kullanıldığını da bildirir. Hayvan türü çekirdektir, insana aktarım ise bağımlı bir genişlemedir.

concept_map.definition: Çöl sıçanlarının küçük ve kısa, kimi anlatımlarda biçimi kötü ve eti sıkı bir türüdür. Aynı niteleme, aşağılık görülen bir erkek için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çöl sıçanları içinde ayrı bir türü adlandıran hayvan nitelemesidir.
Tür, kimi anlatımda küçük ve kısa, kiminde biçimi kötü ve eti sıkı olarak betimlenir.
Hayvan için kullanılan niteleme, aşağılık görülen bir erkeği belirtmek üzere insana aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar belirli bir çöl sıçanı türünü adlandırır; betimlemeler küçüklük ve kısalık ile kötü biçim ve sıkı et arasında değişir. Nitelemenin aşağılık görülen bir erkeğe aktarılması da aynı dal içinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yalnız belirli bir olumsuz ev cümlesinde hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıbı aktarır ve onu aynı işlevdeki başka sözlerle eş tutar. Bu, sözün bağımsız bir kişi adı olduğu anlamına değil, kalıp içindeki en küçük varlığı bile dışlayan işlevine dayanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız evde tek bir kişinin bile olmadığını söyleyen sabit olumsuz yapıda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam bütünüyle verilen olumsuz cümle kalıbına bağlıdır; içindeki ayırt edici söz bağımsız olarak kimse anlamına genellenemez.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız belirli bir olumsuz ev kalıbında, evde tek bir kişinin bile bulunmadığını bildirir. İçindeki ayırt edici sözün bağımsız bir kişi adı olduğu sonucu çıkarılmaz.

facets.statement: Olumsuz ev cümlesi, evde hiçbir insanın bulunmadığını en küçük olasılığı da dışlayarak bildirir.
Kalıp içindeki söz, aynı cümle düzeninde hiç kimse bulunmadığını bildiren başka sözlerle eşdeğer sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, belirli bir ev cümlesinde hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp işlevinde birleşir. Bir anlatım aynı yokluk anlamını veren birkaç farklı sözü yan yana göstererek yapının kalıplaşmış niteliğini doğrular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız verilen olumsuz ev kalıbının bütün insan varlığını dışlayan anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Evde tek bir kişinin bile bulunmaması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sabit olumsuz yapının Türkçe cümle içinde doğal ve güçlü bir karşılığı olarak kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kavramsal çekirdek, yer sınırı ve kalıp içindeki işlev aynıdır; ayrım yalnız aynı olumsuz yuvayı dolduran kaynak dildeki farklı sözlerdedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kalıplar incelendi; tam eşdeğerlerden biri yinelenmeyi önlemek için seçildi, insan dışı yokluğa uzanan komşu da sınır karşılaştırması için tutuldu. Anlamı artışın yokluğu olan ve yalnız biçimsel olarak benzeyen adaylar elendi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, keskinlik veya iş görme gücünün azalmasıyla insanın, hayvanın, rüzgarın ve duyuların yorulmasını aynı çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal bu ortak güçten düşme sınırını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bütünlük bildiren kullanımları ve mirasla ilgili akrabalık anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın güçten düşme anlamını kapsar; bineği yorma anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen ettirgen söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın, hayvanın, aracın, organın ya da etkin gücün keskinliğini, dayanma gücünü veya iş görme yetisini yitirerek körelmesi ya da yorulmasıdır. Bineği bu duruma düşürme, ayrıca belirli bir ettirgen söz öbeğinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keskinlik, dayanma gücü veya etkinlik kaybının birlikte anlatıldığı dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem körelmeyi hem de yorularak güçten düşmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüme ve çalışma sonucu güçten düştüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taşıyıcının yorulma ve güç kaybını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç, dil, bakış veya başka bir etkin yetinin keskinliğini yitirdiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Keskinlik ve etkinlik kaybını doğal bir Türkçe karşılıkla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil, duyu ve rüzgar gibi taşıyıcılarda keskinlik veya etkinlik kaybını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yürüme sonucunda insanın veya hayvanın yorulup güçten düşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedensel yorgunlukla sınırlıyken bu dal, aynı güç kaybını araçların keskinliği ile dilin ve duyuların etkinliğine de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil ve rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücün tümüyle tükenmesi, bıkkınlık ve eldekinin bitmesi komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yorgunluk, bakışın zayıflaması ve gücün kesilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal körelme ile yorulmayı geniş bir taşıyıcı dizisine uygular; komşu dal ise tükenme, kesilme ve bıkkınlık sonucunu daha belirgin kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız bedensel yorgunluk ve güç tükenmesiyle gerçek anlam örtüşmesi kuran iki komşu yayımlandı, aynı kökün öteki eşsesli dalları ayrım sağlamadığı için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كلال السيف واللسان والطرف والسمع والبصر، وإعياء الماشي والبعير والراحلة والريح

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ağırlık fiziksel ağırlık değil, bir başkasının üstlendiği bakım ve geçim yüküdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geçim, bakım veya taşıma sorumluluğunun başka bir kişiye düştüğü çekirdek ilişkiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağımlı olan tarafı ve yükü üstlenen başka tarafı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin geçimini sağlamak zorunda olduğu aile veya yakınlar için uygundur.
